Start: Krark, the Thumbless (battlefield); Earthcraft (battlefield); Sakashima of a Thousand Faces (battlefield: as a copy of Krark)

  When you cast that spell, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.

  Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
  Blink Sanar using Lilysplash Mentor. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
  Repeat each turn.
Notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

  Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
  Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
  Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
Notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

  Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.

  Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.

  Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.

Produces: Infinite combat phases; Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite untap of lands you control
Start: Bruce Banner // The Incredible Hulk (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Desert (battlefield); Pip-Boy 3000 (battlefield: attached to The Incredible Hulk)
Prerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
Steps: Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker, triggering the ability given to it by Pip-Boy 3000, untapping all lands you control.
  During the end of combat step, activate Desert's second ability by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
  The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and then untapping it and causing you to gain an additional combat phase after this one.
  Repeat each combat phase.

## Combo 7506-7845--178--179
Cards: Spinerock Tyrant + Repudiate // Replicate
Color identity: GUR | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 14 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}{G}{G}{U}{U}
Produces: Infinite Treasure tokens; Infinite colored mana; Infinite copies of creatures you control; Infinite artifact tokens; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite storm count; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers
Requires: Instant or Sorcery that Targets a Creature and Creates Treasure (hand)
Requires: Creature that Returns an Instant or Sorcery from Graveyard to Hand on Entering (battlefield)
Start: Spinerock Tyrant (battlefield); Repudiate // Replicate (hand)
Steps: Cast Replicate by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
  When you cast that spell, Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Replicate and choosing Spinerock Tyrant as its target.
  Resolve the copy of Replicate, creating a Spinerock Tyrant token.
  Resolve the original Replicate, creating a token copy of the spell recursion creature.
  When that token enters, it triggers, returning Repudiate // Replicate from your graveyard to your hand.
  Repeat from step 1 one additional time, resulting in a total of five Spinerock Tyrants.
  Cast the spell that creates a Treasure token by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature.
  Each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying that spell once for each Spinerock Tyrant you control.
  Resolve all copies of that spell, creating at least one Treasure token each time.
  Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana per Treasure.
  Cast Replicate by paying its mana cost targeting the spell recursion creature.
  When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Replicate once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing the spell recursion creature once and Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target.
  Resolve all copies of that spell, creating two copies of the spell recursion creature and additional copies of Spinerock Tyrant.
  When the first spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning the spell that creates Treasure from your graveyard to your hand.
   When the second spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning Repudiate // Replicate from your graveyard to your hand.
  Repeat from step 7.
Notes: The mana needed is calculated assuming you use a spell that costs 2 to cast and creates one Treasure token.
